compatibility: exact base digest required; schema major must match; migration to another release requires explicit validated remap and human acceptance
conflicts: retain all competing proposals; require human disposition; no silent last-write-wins
export: base files never incorporate local evidence; local classification/access controls and export review belong to overlay host
extensions: namespaced extension object; never add local fields to base files
namespace: local:<organization>:<uuid>; project:<uuid> for project model identities
references: base:<release_id>:<existing_id>, with dataset where identity is shared by projections
